offering_description.value: Operates supermarkets in the southeastern United States that sell groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy products and general merchandise to households. Earns revenue from in-store and fuel center sales made directly to shoppers at its own locations.

primary_products.value: groceries; fresh produce; meat and seafood; prepared foods; general merchandise; fuel

primary_services.value: pharmacy services; online order pickup and delivery

customer_segment.value: B2C: households shopping for groceries, pharmacy items and fuel

revenue_model.value: product sales: groceries, general merchandise and fuel sold to shoppers; healthcare reimbursement: prescription payments from insurers and pharmacy benefit programs

value_chain_position.value: retailer: buys food and goods from suppliers and sells them to households through its stores

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern states, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee and Virginia

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line of supermarkets with in-store pharmacies and fuel centers

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated supermarkets and fuel centers; online: online ordering for pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medium: food safety rules, pharmacy licensing and alcohol sales rules from state and federal regulators

notes: Exact states and store count are from general knowledge and may be out of date.
